items.title: Quiet Light – “Hi, Society” (Ms* Gloom Cover)
items.summary: Quiet Light's Blue Angel Sparkling Silver 2 is easily one of this year's best albums , even if it was promoted as a mixtape. Today the performer known as Riya Mahesh has shined her hushed glow on another artist's track from last year. LA alt-pop singer Ms* Gloom 's original recording of "Hi, Society" is a crystalline, beat-driven electro-pop track that reminds me of early Purity Ring. Mahesh has pared it down to a soft, sparse ballad. items.title: Elvis Costello Shares Previously Unreleased Original Version Of “I Turn Around” From My Aim Is True 49th Anniversary Edition
items.summary: Last month, Elvis Costello announced a 49th anniversary edition of his debut album My Aim Is True , saying that the idea of a 50th anniversary edition struck him as "preposterous" and "made [his] teeth itch." The five-CD box set features 104 tracks, 52 of which are previously unreleased. He shared a bunch of versions of his 1977 single "Watching The Detectives," and now he's releasing the original version of "I Turn Around." The label is using the term "mixtape" to refer to Maximum MN , but we already know that it's the kind of classic compilation that Sub Pop might've release decades ago. This particular release is a benefit for the International Institute Of Minnesota , an organization that aids immigrants and refugees, in the wake of ICE's murderous raids on the state.
